shared_elements: stone surface carved in low relief
incised linear detailing (possible script-like or ornamental marks)
justification: Both are vertically oriented stone objects with a rounded top and carved decoration organised in stacked horizontal zones, and both include a human-derived figure and disc-like circular motifs. The difference is decisive: A is a heavily weathered, dark, fully three-dimensional volumetric block whose ornament is abstract and worn onto a body-shaped mass, while B is a flat, pale plaque with crisp, thin, linear low-relief narrative figures making offerings — utterly different in medium finish, scale of detail and pictorial intent.
